shared_elements: suggestion of a face or head at the top of the stone
justification: Both are pale, weathered stone monoliths in which a pair of hollowed eye-like features sits high on the block, giving each a vaguely face-bearing upper zone. Beyond that, A is a flat slab covered with fine low-relief registers of animals, banded pattern and small figures in an ordered vertical sequence, while B is a rough, largely undecorated three-dimensional head-like boulder with only crude massed volumes and no relief imagery or registers.
